newsitem.title: MEXICO: Robbers take hostage in Mexico bank siege.
newsitem.headline: Robbers take hostage in Mexico bank siege.

text.p: Armed robbers were holding at least one woman hostage inside a bank on Monday after a brief shootout with police who foiled their attempted holdup.

Television pictures showed three dozen armed police officers hiding behind parked cars outside a Bancomer branch in the eastern part of the capital, pointing handguns and shotguns through the open door of the bank.
An unknown number of robbers were holed up inside and had taken at least one hostage, an unidentified woman, TV network Televisa said.
One officer was injured in the hand in a brief exchange of gunfire as police arrived at the bank when the robbery was just starting, Televisa said.
Police reinforcements arrived at the scene, which was sealed off to traffic. Curious onlookers, many coming out of the subway station that overlooked the branch, flocked to see the unfolding drama.
